name: Brain core
purpose: facts with provenance, sequenced into numbered deltas with state roots, produced by models that run on members' own CLIs through the relay.
exit_gate: replaying the event log gives identical state roots; extraction eval at its threshold (F1 0.85).
traps: never hash JSON text (key order differs between serializers); never let a CLI keep tools on "just for extraction".
note: `passes` is set only by CI after a task's acceptance tests pass there. Dependencies default to the previous task in the phase; loosen them when tasks are independent. Areas are a first guess; one agent per area at a time.

tasks.title: Sequencer: single writer per tenant, numbered deltas per scope, canonical encoding, state roots, push to subscribers.
spec_refs: README: Company brain (Fact model, Extraction pipeline), Sync engine, Core runtime (Model access, Model relay), Data model. Section 11.4 to 11.7 of this guide.
acceptance: replaying the whole event log from empty gives identical state roots; a result with a bad signature, wrong schema, wrong scope or missing taint is rejected; a node outside a scope never receives that scope's offers; a sampled re-run that disagrees pauses the node; locked-mode canary (Section 11.6) passes for every enabled provider; extraction eval at threshold.
